shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; ls /workspace/app; echo "---"; ls /workspace
find /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -50; echo "---EVAL.ts---"; find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -name "EVAL.ts"
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -80
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -80

d=/workspace; while :; do
  grep -Hm1 '^description:' "$d"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
  [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ] && break
  d=$(dirname "$d")
done
which chromium-cli 2>/dev/null; ls /tmp/claude-1000/bundled-skills/2.1.267/b191a5fc9c452a8adb2a29d6e6dd4821/run/examples/
(npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &) && timeout 40 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && echo READY
which chromium-cli || npx chromium-cli --version 2>&1 | head -5

node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1; node -e "require.resolve('playwright-core')" 2>&1; npm ls playwright 2>&1 | head -5; find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*playwright*" -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v /proc | head -20
timeout 60 npm i -D playwright --no-save 2>&1 | tail -20
timeout 90 npx playwright install chromium --with-deps 2>&1 | tail -40
timeout 90 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -40
node /tmp/verify.mjs 2>&1
cp /tmp/verify.mjs /workspace/__verify.mjs && cd /workspace && node __verify.mjs 2>&1

rm -f /workspace/__verify.mjs /tmp/verify.mjs
echo "--- GET /catalog?category=sale (raw HTML, should have no server-rendered heading/products) ---"
curl -s "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o '<h[12]>[^<]*</h[12]>\|Loading category' 
echo "--- timing /api/catalog?category=sale (expect ~800ms) ---"
time curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/catalog?category=sale"
echo
echo "--- timing /api/catalog?category=featured ---"
time curl -s "http://localhost:3000/api/catalog?category=featured"
echo
lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill; sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:3000 -m 2 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"

pid=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk '/:3000/{print $NF}' | grep -oP 'pid=\K[0-9]+' | head -1)
if [ -z "$pid" ]; then
  pid=$(fuser -n tcp 3000 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ' )
fi
echo "pid=$pid"
[ -n "$pid" ] && kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
ps aux | grep -i next | grep -v grep
kill 439 451 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
git status --short

echo "--- AGENTS.md ---"; cat /workspace/AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- CLAUDE.md ---"; cat /workspace/CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- tsconfig.json diff ---"; git diff tsconfig.json
echo "--- package.json diff ---"; git diff package.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null

cd /workspace
git checkout -- tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md
git status --short
git diff package.json; echo "---node_modules/.bin check playwright---"; ls node_modules/.bin/playwright* 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules | grep -i playwright
grep -c playwright /workspace/package-lock.json
npm install --package-lock-only 2>&1 | tail -10 && grep -c playwright package-lock.json

npm uninstall playwright --no-save 2>&1 | tail -10
rm -rf node_modules/playwright node_modules/playwright-core node_modules/.bin/playwright node_modules/.bin/playwright-core
npm install --package-lock-only 2>&1 | tail -10
grep -c playwright package-lock.json
grep -n playwright package-lock.json
grep -n '"node_modules/playwright' package-lock.json; echo "done"; git status --short
npx tsc --noEmit && echo OK
